Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-007 (Store Operations - I) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • The retail store scenario in India, floor walk, customers and consumers, HR in retail, candidate sources, centralised warehouse, GMROI
  • Space planning and space mix, assets and depreciation, Standard Operating Procedures, transaction drivers, cashiering, offline and online integration

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-007/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions of 10 marks each (as printed). Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
